repos.name: internet-court/internet-court-skill
repos.description: The trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce — natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 delegated permissions, x402 payments, escrow, and dispute resolution as one open, catch-all Agent Skill / Claude Code plugin.
repos.one_liner: A trust and commerce layer for agent-to-agent transactions using delegated permissions and escrow.
bullets: Built on TypeScript, integrating ERC-7710 for delegated permissions and x402 payment protocols.
Provides a standardized 'Agent Skill' for dispute resolution and secure commerce between autonomous entities.
Enables complex agent-to-agent economic interactions by codifying natural-language mandates into executable logic.
Essential for the emerging agentic economy where agents need to handle payments and contractual obligations.

repos.name: unslothai/unsloth
repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.one_liner: High-performance framework for training and fine-tuning LLMs with significantly reduced memory usage.
bullets: Utilizes optimized kernels and Triton to accelerate training of models like DeepSeek-V4, Qwen, and Llama.
Reduces VRAM consumption by up to 70%, making fine-tuning accessible on consumer-grade hardware.
Supports seamless integration with Hugging Face ecosystem for rapid deployment of custom-trained models.
Critical infrastructure for enterprises building proprietary, domain-specific AI models.

repos.name: holaboss-ai/holaOS
repos.description: Open-source All in One AI agent workspace. Run any agent — Claude Code, Codex — across your tools (100+ integrations + MCP), apps, browser, and files, with shared memory. Built-in models or BYOK.
repos.one_liner: An all-in-one AI agent workspace designed to orchestrate multiple agents across tools and files.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture supporting 100+ integrations and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Features shared memory across agents, allowing for persistent context in complex workflows.
Supports both built-in models and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for flexibility in enterprise environments.
Acts as a centralized control plane for managing agentic tasks across browser, desktop, and cloud environments.

repos.name: microsoft/data-formulator
repos.description: 🪄 Data Formulator is an interactive AI-powered data analysis system makes it easy to connect, explore and visualize data.
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered data analysis and visualization system that simplifies complex data exploration.
bullets: Combines LLM-driven natural language processing with interactive data transformation and visualization tools.
Automates the creation of charts and data insights, reducing the barrier to entry for complex data analysis.
Designed for data professionals to quickly iterate on datasets and generate high-quality visual reports.
Leverages AI to bridge the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence.

repos.name: ifixai-ai/iFixAi
repos.description: Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.
repos.one_liner: An independent auditing framework designed to verify that AI agents are executing tasks as intended.
bullets: Python-based auditing engine that can be triggered by humans or autonomous agents themselves.
Provides a verification layer to ensure agentic outputs align with predefined goals and safety constraints.
Addresses the critical 'AI alignment' problem in production environments where agents handle sensitive operations.
Essential for fintech and high-stakes industries requiring observability and accountability in automated workflows.
